mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.email, p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name, p.birth_date, p.nationality, u.created_at AS registered_at FROM account_user u JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE account_profile SET first_name = #{firstName}, middle_name = #{middleName}, last_name = #{lastName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, nationality = #{nationality} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
